description: A Mermaid diagram block that shows just the diagram, with hover actions to copy, edit and delete. Edit opens a split code and live preview editor with Apply and Cancel, and the preview re-renders 300ms after you stop typing, following light and dark mode. Insert one from the slash menu as "Diagram". Mermaid is loaded on first use, and the source round-trips as a fenced mermaid block in markdown.
